BL-690 — `./swarm ensure` cannot restart handoffd: its daemon repair runs the health PROBE, which alarms and halts the swarm instead of starting the daemon
What it solves: Ordering note for the coordinator: this is a `high` defect, so Article 3.2.4
expedites it ahead of non-expedited candidates. It is orthogonal to BL-688 and
BL-689 (different tree entirely — `swarmforge/scripts/` vs
`extension/src/quality`), so it can run alongside either if a slot allows.
Approval context: The operator's intake recommends Option A (point `ensure-daemon!` at the same lifecycle script the launch paths already use) over Option B (teach `handoffd_supervisor.bb --check-once` a `--repair` flag). This ticket specifies Option A, because Option B would put a start path inside the halt-authori…
BL-690 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-690" (or "reject BL-690 <reason>") to act.
